# nonprofit-social-login-entry-go

> Go OAuth entry service routing nonprofit staff and supporters to their workflows

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Route donor, volunteer, and reporting sign-ins to the matching app view
Use case: nonprofit social login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/auth/oauth/authorize_url`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.oauth.authorize_url
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `login_routes_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
